senses.gloss: (preced.) [to dig around, denom. כְּרוֹבָא, fr. which כְּרַב] to plough.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 96b:7">B. Kam. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ בהו כרבא</he> (Ms. M. omits <cite ref="K01079"><he>כרבא</he></cite>) he ploughed with them.
<cite ref="Shabbat 33b:7">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite> … <he>חזו כַּרְבֵי וזרעי</he> they saw people plough and sow.

<cite ref="Shabbat 73b:2">Ib. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>מכדי מִכְרַב כרבי ברישא</he> do not people first plough (and then sow)? <cite ref="Shabbat 73b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>בא״י … והדר כרבי</he> the Mishnah speaks of Palestine where they first sow and then plough.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 105a:6">B. Mets. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>כָּרֵיבְנָא לה</he> I shall plough it over.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107a:3">Ib. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>כָּרֵיב ותני</he> he ploughs twice (after harvesting and before seed-time); a. e.
